create_scheduler: create a FlaxLMSDiscreteScheduler with custom beta schedule, prediction type, and dtype for diffusion inference
set_timesteps: set the inference timesteps and interpolated sigmas for the LMS discrete scheduler state
step_diffusion: step the diffusion process forward using the LMS multistep method to predict the previous sample
scale_model_input: scale the denoising model input by sigma squared plus one to match the K-LMS algorithm
add_noise: add sigma-scaled noise to original samples using the LMS discrete scheduler state
